about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-54, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 2 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: Coverage ledger: every facilitator, chain, language, scheme, transport and extension has evidence, a task, or a stated out-of-reach reason
tasks.description: tools/coverage_ledger.py reads docs/coverage-ledger.json (seeded from the public inventory: docs.x402.org facilitators, the 2026-10-20 live run, the self-hosted columns, facilitators.x402.watch, GitHub search, the upstream e2e mechanisms catalog and sdk-features table) and joins each row to evidence/** and proofline.json. Each row is one of: evidence (link + SHA256SUMS), task (an XC id that will produce evidence), or out-of-reach (reason from a fixed list: hosted-only, mainnet-only, needs-credentials, needs-proprietary-runtime, spec-only-no-implementation). tools/evidence_guard.py is the shared guard every coverage slice uses: it rejects mainnet CAIP-2 ids (allow-list of testnet ids from the upstream catalog), any non-loopback facilitator URL, and /settle calls unless the task allows them. The ledger is a data source for the XC-52 scoreboard, not a score.

criteria.statement: The coverage ledger lists every inventoried facilitator, chain family, SDK language, scheme, transport and extension, each with committed evidence or a stated out-of-reach reason, and no row is 'gap' without a task id

The ledger checker detects a row with neither evidence nor reason, an evidence link whose hash does not verify, a task id that is not in proofline.json, and a hosted row marked as covered by a /verify or /settle run
evidence_guard refuses a mainnet CAIP-2 id, a non-loopback facilitator URL and a /settle call in a verify-only run
The ledger has at least 80 facilitator rows, 17 network-family rows and 7 language rows

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('docs/coverage-ledger.json'));n=lambda k:len(d[k]);print(n('facilitators'),n('chains'),n('languages'));sys.exit(0 if n('facilitators')>=80 and n('chains')>=17 and n('languages')>=7 else 1)"

criteria.statement: CI runs the ledger check on every push
docs/COVERAGE.md links the ledger and states that hosted-only facilitators are out of reach for /verify and /settle
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
